summary: Add an opt-in subject activity summary for runtime ownership readers, avoiding full claim provenance and harness history replay.

schema.detail: No storage or client-v0 schema or generated client changes.

compatibility.detail: subject show --activity-summary reads legacy /v1/status?activity_summary=true for an agent. The status envelope retains store_index and subject identity; actual contains observed status, workspace and host. A current roster-cache entry is exact; otherwise at most 64 candidates are folded. Unresolved fields are null, complete is false and unresolved names the fields. Full status remains the default.

manual.detail: Consumers can opt into subject show SUBJECT --activity-summary --json --daemon-wait 0 after upgrading daemon and CLI. Require status.complete=true and status.unresolved=[]; incomplete evidence is not reclaimable. Older daemons do not provide these completeness markers.

recovery.detail: Remove the opt-in flag to restore full inspection.
